title: Search multiple surfaces for multiple required objects
description: Use when a task requires collecting more than one instance of an object type.
content: When a task asks for multiple objects of the same type, do not assume they are all in one location. Check different surfaces and containers around the room, and collect each instance one at a time before moving them to the target.

source.task_query: Your task is to: put two keychain in drawer.

title: Locate target object by exploring multiple storage locations
description: Use when the target object is not immediately visible in the first location you check.
content: When searching for a specific object, systematically visit nearby storage furniture such as shelves. The target object may be on a different shelf than the first one examined, so continue exploring until the object is found.

source.task_query: Your task is to: put a statue in sidetable.

title: Place carried object at destination using move command
description: Use when you have arrived at the destination with the target object in your inventory.
content: After navigating to the destination furniture, use the move action to place the carried object onto that furniture. This completes the task of putting an object in or on a target location.

source.task_query: Your task is to: put a statue in sidetable.

title: Cool heated objects using a fridge before placing them
description: Use this when a task requires cooling an object that was found on a heat source such as a stoveburner.
content: After picking up a hot object, go to the fridge and use the "cool [object] with [fridge]" action to lower its temperature. The cooling action succeeds even if the fridge appears empty.

source.task_query: Your task is to: cool some pan and put it in countertop.

title: Use appliances to modify object temperature
description: Use this when an object needs to be heated or cooled as part of a task.
content: After obtaining the object, go to the appropriate appliance (e.g., fridge for cooling) and use the appliance-specific action on the object. The environment will confirm when the temperature change is complete.

source.task_query: Your task is to: put a cool apple in garbagecan.

title: Search common surfaces before opening storage containers
description: Use this when looking for small portable objects such as watches, keys, or phones.
content: When searching for small objects, first check open surfaces like tables and counters, because they often hold the target items directly. Only after checking visible surfaces should you open drawers or other closed storage.

source.task_query: Your task is to: put two watch in shelf.

title: Heat objects with the microwave by placing them inside first
description: Use this when a task requires heating an object and a microwave is available.
content: To heat an object in a microwave, first open the microwave, move the object into it, and then use the heat action. Attempting to heat while the microwave is open or while the object is not inside will fail with "Nothing happens."

source.task_query: Your task is to: heat some plate and put it in sidetable.

title: Retry failed take actions after examining
description: Use when a take action fails with "Nothing happens" despite the object being visible.
content: If taking an object fails with "Nothing happens," examine the surface first to confirm the object is still there, then retry the take action. The failure may be transient, and a subsequent attempt can succeed.

source.task_query: Your task is to: find two toiletpaper and put them in drawer.

title: Locate the target object before taking it
description: Use this when a task requires picking up an object that may be found on a countertop or other surface.
content: Search likely surfaces such as countertops for the target object, examine the area to confirm its presence, and then take the specific object needed for the task.

source.task_query: Your task is to: clean some egg and put it in fridge.

title: Pick up the target object before examining it with a tool
description: Use this when you need to examine an object that is not at the same location as the required tool.
content: If the object to be examined is in a different location than the tool, go to the object's location, take the object into inventory, then return to the tool's location to complete the examination.

source.task_query: Your task is to: examine the pillow with the desklamp.

title: Open closed containers before checking their contents
description: Use when encountering a closed cabinet or fridge during object search.
content: Closed cabinets and fridges must be opened before their contents can be examined. If a cabinet is closed, open it first; if it is already open, examine it directly to see what is inside.

source.task_query: Your task is to: cool some mug and put it in coffeemachine.

title: Search multiple cabinets before checking countertops for target objects
description: Use when looking for a small object like a mug that is not in the first few storage locations.
content: When searching for a target object, do not assume it is in the first cabinet opened; systematically check other cabinets and then countertops. The target may be on a countertop rather than inside a cabinet, so include countertops in the search path.

source.task_query: Your task is to: clean some mug and put it in coffeemachine.
